name: UnSub (ARTEX extortion and suspected PRC-nexus clusters) — GTIG
akas: Financially motivated extortion groups and suspected PRC-nexus clusters; no GTIG UNC designation given
brief: GTIG/Mandiant report that since late August 2026 multiple actors have operated ARTEX (autonomous multi-agent LLM pentesting/C2 platform written in Go, using frontier and open-source model APIs) in incident-response engagements: data-theft extortion groups and suspected PRC-nexus clusters hit US government, technology, chemicals/materials and manufacturing. Observed behavior included self-correcting scripts and web shells, MySQL general_log poisoning to write JSP web shells, Kerberoasting, DCSync, 27 AWS probing events in 23 seconds, 491 rotating webhook.site C2 URLs, and enumeration of 110,000+ AD objects. *Analyst note: victim counts and MITRE IDs not stated by GTIG (IDs analyst-mapped); the Asia financial-sector ARTEX case GTIG cites is the already-tracked CrowdStrike row. Vendor source.* GTIG
